row.evidence: Appsmith's pricing page lists "User provisioning and group sync through SCIM" under Enterprise ($2,500 / month for 100 users, "Everything in Business, plus"), and the SCIM setup doc is labelled Enterprise.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: Business $15/user/mo (billed monthly by card, no annual price shown), Enterprise $2,500/mo for 100 users (Unlimited users starting at 100), normalised to $25/u/mo for the multiplier; min_seats 100 inferred from 'Unlimited (starting at 100)'. SAML/OIDC SSO is also Enterprise; Free and Business only get Google and GitHub OAuth. SCIM docs list a self-hosted instance as a prerequisite and SCIM does not need SAML configured. Okta and Entra are set up as custom apps against the instance's SCIM 2.0 endpoint (no catalogue app found); docs say Google Workspace cannot be used. No user-management REST API is documented (only health/monitoring APIs); audit logs (Business) are exported by querying the instance's MongoDB.

plans.name: Business
plans.price_text: $15 / month per user, up to 99 users
plans.notes: Audit logs included (UI and MongoDB export, no audit-log REST API documented). Google and GitHub OAuth only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Users: Unlimited (starting at 100). Per-user figure is $2,500/100. Enterprise typically billed annually per agreement.

auth.token_source: Admin Settings > Access Control > Provisioning > User Provisioning & Group Sync > Configure > Generate API key
auth.notes: Key is encrypted with APPSMITH_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD/SALT; it breaks if those change on upgrade.

attributes.notes: Docs tell admins to delete every Entra mapping except userPrincipalName, displayName and the Switch([IsSoftDeleted]) expression (Entra's default mapping for active); Okta mappings reduced to Username and Display name. Email can be used as the unique identifier instead of userName.

roles.notes: Roles are assigned to groups inside Appsmith; docs do not describe a SCIM roles attribute.

limitations.text: SCIM setup doc lists a self-hosted Appsmith instance as a prerequisite; the IdP must reach the instance over HTTPS.
Google Workspace cannot be used for SCIM provisioning.
All user and group changes must be made in the IdP; direct changes in Appsmith cause discrepancies.
SCIM API key stops working if the encryption password/salt change during upgrades.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs (Business) are viewed in Admin Settings and exported by querying the auditlog collection in the instance's MongoDB; no REST endpoint documented.

limitations.text: The only documented instance APIs are monitoring endpoints (GET /api/v1/health, GET /api/v1/consolidated-api/view); user management is done in the Admin UI.

okta.notes: Docs configure an existing custom Okta app with SCIM enabled; no OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/appsmith/ returned 404). listed=false is from that 404, not a vendor statement.

entra.notes: Docs configure the existing (non-gallery) enterprise application connected to Appsmith; no Entra gallery tutorial found (404).

google.notes: Appsmith says Google Workspace does not support SCIM; Google OAuth sign-in is available on all plans.

conflicts.text: The pricing page lists SCIM as an Enterprise feature without a hosting caveat (Enterprise also offers managed cloud hosting as an add-on), while the SCIM setup doc lists a self-hosted instance as a prerequisite.

open_questions: Docs do not say what SCIM deprovisioning does (deactivate vs delete), whether it frees the seat, or whether sessions end.
SCIM operations beyond create, profile push and group push (PUT vs PATCH, deactivate, delete) are not documented.
Whether SCIM works on Appsmith cloud (managed hosting) or only self-hosted is unclear.
No user-management REST API is documented; unclear whether one exists.
SCIM filtering, pagination, discovery endpoints and rate limits are not documented.
OneLogin and JumpCloud are not mentioned in the SCIM docs.
Whether SAML/OIDC sign-in creates users just-in-time is not documented.
